subject: general
question: What is the name of the Southernmost tip of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Indira Point__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indira Point** is located **on the Great Nicobar Island**, which is a part of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• It is the **southernmost tip of Indian territory.**
 
• It was **previously known as Pygmalion Point** before being renamed as Indira Point in honor of the former Indian Prime Minister, Indira Gandhi.
 
• The area around Indira Point is prone to earthquakes and tsunamis due to its location in the seismic zone.
 
• The **Indira Point lighthouse** was **commissioned **into service on **30 April 1972.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indira Col **is located on the **Indira Ridge of Siachen Muztagh in the Karakoram Range**.

 
 
• It is a **high-altitude pass** located** in the Himalayas**, near the India-China border.
 
 
 
• **Karakoram** is a** mountain range located** in the northern part of the Indian subcontinent, **near **the** borders of India, Pakistan, and China.**
 
• **Point Calimere** is a cape located on the southeastern coast of India, in the state of Tamil Nadu.
 
 
• It is the **easternmost point of Tamil Nadu.**
